{{Quote|Captain Eclipse&mdash;we're picking up five, no, six small warships coming in fa&mdash;|[[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Yat-De Viedas]] to Captain Juno Eclipse, just before ''Lexi Dio'' is destroyed|<ref name="The Force Unleashed II (novel)" />}}
'''''Lexi Dio''''' was an [[Bomber/Legends|assault bomber]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The vessel shared its name with<ref name="The Force Unleashed II (novel)" /> [[Senator]] [[Lexi Dio/Legends|Lexi Dio]].<ref name="AOTC VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUIIComic" /> it fought alongside other Rebel [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse's]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']], to defend against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|assault]] on a Rebel [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] hidden near the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]]. It was the first ship to be destroyed during the battle when seven small vessels attacked the Rebel starships. ''Lexi Dio'' was already badly damaged when four of the ships blasted it with [[Missile/Legends|missiles]], which split it from nose to stern. The instant loss of compression resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of everyone aboard. Captain Eclipse responded to the attack by ordering the fleet to disperse.<ref name="The Force Unleashed II (novel)" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Lexi Dio'' appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]], written by [[Sean Williams]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="The Force Unleashed II (novel)" /> Although several starships are seen as part of the fleet in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', released the same year, the game does not make a specific mention of ''Lexi Dio''.<ref name="TFUII game">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>
